what: The hero photo and the wordmark above it follow the scroll more slowly — while the frame is on screen, each is pushed down by its own height × value according to progress (0→1). Giving different values, like photo .5 and wordmark .4, makes the text rise slightly faster than the photo so the layers separate. No curve, tied directly to scroll

duration.Scroll: While the frame passes across the screen

options.value: Fraction multiplied by my height — distance pushed at the end, default .5 (0 means it doesn’t move)
options.min: Minimum window width to activate (px), default 0
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Frame (ancestor) used to measure progress. If none, the direct parent — give the frame overflow: clip so shifted photos do not spill out
options.range: For frame, progress is measured from when the frame’s top edge hits the top of the screen until its bottom edge hits the top (ScrollTrigger start top top · end bottom top · scrub true) — the default is from when the frame enters from the bottom of the screen until it leaves the top · Brand hero five shapes value 1

use: BRAND
note: The original measures with Lenis animatedScroll and a lerp of 1, so it follows immediately. This part reads the window (or data-fx-scroller) scroll on every gsap.ticker

from.where: index.html .hm-first__kv (photo .5 · wordmark .4) · about.html .ky-sec-first__kv — original data-parallax-img="fixed-top" data-parallax-img-value
index.html .fes-hero .ofk-shape, five of them (value: 1; range: frame) — original .p-fes-main-visual__shapes figure yPercent 100, trigger Hero top top → bottom top, ease none, scrub true
